articles.summary: Kodiak, the leader in AI-powered autonomous trucking, announces plans to go public via merger with Ares Acquisition Corporation II. With 2.6M+ autonomous miles, commercial operations underway, and a $4T+ market opportunity, Kodiak is scaling driverless freight.
articles.title: Kodiak, a Leading Provider of AI-Powered Autonomous Vehicle Technology, to Go Public Via Business Combination With Ares Acquisition Corporation II
